title: Maria and the Bus
text:
Maria takes the bus to school every day. The bus stop is near her house. She looks at the bus timetable before she leaves. The bus leaves at 7:30 in the morning.

The map shows the bus route. The route goes past the park and the library. Maria gets off at the school stop. The trip takes fifteen minutes.

questions.text: What does Maria take to school?
How long does the trip take?
Why does Maria look at the timetable before she leaves?
options: To find out when the bus leaves

questions.text: What can you infer about the bus route?
options: It goes past places in the town
It only goes to the park
It does not stop at school

vocabulary.definition: a list that shows when buses, trains or classes happen
the way that a bus or car travels from one place to another
a place where people borrow books
a place where a bus stops so people can get on or off

paragraph_translations: María toma el autobús a la escuela todos los días. La parada del autobús está cerca de su casa. Ella mira el horario del autobús antes de salir. El autobús sale a las 7:30 de la mañana.
El mapa muestra la ruta del autobús. La ruta pasa por el parque y la biblioteca. María baja en la parada de la escuela. El viaje dura quince minutos.
